newsitem.title: ALBANIA: One dead, one hurt in Albania gangster shoot-out.
newsitem.headline: One dead, one hurt in Albania gangster shoot-out.

text.p: An elderly woman died and another woman was wounded when two gangsters tried to gun down a man in the Albanian capital on Tuesday before fleeing the scene by car, police said.
"The old woman was shot in the head," a shaken witness said. A policeman said the woman died immediately.

It was the latest in a series of violent crimes which have shocked the Balkan nation this summer. Earlier this month, a 65-year old woman died and eight people were wounded in crossfire between two rival gangster bands in the port city of Durres.
Last month, two policemen brothers were killed in an ambush, while in July a police chief and a prison chief were shot dead, allegedly by gangsters.
